start.title: Murmurs in the Dust
start.text:
The camp grows restless again.
Voices rise against the long road.

choices.text: Walk among them and listen
choices.feedback: Numbers 11:1 — The people complained about their hardships, and the Lord heard them.

choices.text: Shout them into silence
Pretend you do not hear

shout_consequence.title: Lead with Patience
shout_consequence.text:
Force will not silence fear.
Go and listen instead.

choices.text: Walk among them and listen

ignore_consequence.title: A Shepherd Stays
ignore_consequence.text:
Silence will not heal them.
Go where their cry is loudest.

choices.text: Walk among them and listen

complaints.title: "Were There No Graves in Egypt?"
complaints.text:
"Why bring us out to die here?"
Their hands clench in the dust.

choices.text: Agree the journey is hopeless
Promise quick comfort to please them
Remind them what God has done
choices.feedback: Numbers 14:3 — Moses reminded the people that the Lord had brought them out of Egypt.

agree_consequence.title: Stand on His Word
agree_consequence.text:
His promise has not failed.
Speak truth, not despair.

choices.text: Remind them what God has done

promise_consequence.title: Do Not Flatter Them
promise_consequence.text:
Soothing lies cannot save them.
Point to the One who can.

choices.text: Remind them what God has done
choices.feedback: You raise your staff in memory.

egypt_longing.title: "Let Us Choose a New Leader"
egypt_longing.text:
"Back to Egypt!" some begin to cry.
"Choose a captain. Lead us home."

choices.text: Step aside; let them have their way
Fall on your face before them all
choices.feedback: Numbers 14:5 — Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

choices.text: Curse the rebels in your anger

step_aside_consequence.title: A Shepherd Does Not Flee
step_aside_consequence.text:
He set you over them.
Do not abandon what He gave.

choices.text: Fall on your face before them all

curse_consequence.title: Stand in the Breach
curse_consequence.text:
Wrath cannot save the lost.
Lift a humbler prayer.

choices.text: Fall on your face before them all

intercede.title: On the Hill of Prayer
intercede.text:
You climb away from the noise.
The Lord's voice meets your silence.

choices.text: Ask Him to make a nation of you
Demand He punish them at once
choices.feedback: Mercy is not yours to refuse.

choices.text: Plead for His mercy on them
choices.feedback: Numbers 14:19 — Moses pleaded with the Lord to pardon the iniquity of the people according to the greatness of His mercy.

self_consequence.title: Not for Your Name Alone
self_consequence.text:
Pray for the flock, not yourself.
Mercy is wider than one man.

choices.text: Plead for His mercy on them

demand_consequence.title: Mercy Before Judgment
demand_consequence.text:
He delights to forgive.
Let your prayer match His heart.

choices.text: Plead for His mercy on them
choices.feedback: His anger relents at your words.

joshua_warns.title: Joshua Stands Beside You
joshua_warns.text:
"They must not return to Egypt."
His young face is set like flint.

choices.text: Send Joshua to gather the elders
choices.feedback: Numbers 14:6-7 — Joshua and Caleb tore their clothes and spoke to the congregation, saying the land was an exceedingly good land.

choices.text: Hide Joshua's words from the camp

hide_consequence_2.title: Do Not Bury the Truth
hide_consequence_2.text:
His warning came from the Lord.
Let it be heard.

choices.text: Send Joshua to gather the elders
choices.feedback: His call goes through the camp.

consequences.title: Forty Years in the Wilderness
consequences.text:
"None who doubted will see the land."
The sentence falls like rain.

choices.text: Hide the verdict from the people
choices.feedback: They must hear what is true.

choices.text: Blame Aaron and Joshua before them
Speak the Lord's word plainly
choices.feedback: Numbers 14:28-30 — The Lord declared that none of those who had grumbled would see the land, except Caleb and Joshua.

hide_verdict_consequence.title: Do Not Soften His Word
hide_verdict_consequence.text:
Half-truth is no kindness.
Let them hear it whole.

choices.text: Speak the Lord's word plainly

blame_consequence.title: Carry the Burden Yourself
blame_consequence.text:
You were sent to lead them.
Do not lay the weight on others.

choices.text: Speak the Lord's word plainly

people_mourn.title: A Long Lament
people_mourn.text:
The camp weeps through the night.
Doubt's harvest is bitter.

choices.text: Mock their late-coming sorrow
Sit among them in silence
choices.feedback: Numbers 14:39 — When Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, the people mourned greatly.

mock_consequence.title: Sit With Their Sorrow
mock_consequence.text:
Scorn cannot mend the camp.
Be near them in their pain.

choices.text: Sit among them in silence

ending.title: The Long Road Ahead
ending.text:
Dawn breaks on the wilderness path.
Faith, not fear, will lead them home.
